description: Reuse Agent.Api RequestControl/HistorySync and Executor Status synchronous Channels boundary. Move answering start notification after native ask accepted; opt-in consumer-neutral submission notifications preserve queued/no answer and asynchronous errors without inspecting opaque transport context or introducing new execution owner. Inputs existing Incoming/Event actor opts; confidential admission unchanged; outputs safe lifecycle status through existing upsert, no root/child IDs to widget. Test queued child/no status create, native busy race, terminal admission error and started ordering with real role boundaries where possible. Extend existing Status path; no Action or tools.
title: [zaq-pkd.20] Ordered native start and submission outcome notifications
